name: Ghost of Yotei: Legends
summary:
Ghost of Yötei Legends is an online cooperative multiplayer mode, up to four players, where players can team up with friends to challenge monstrous, supernatural enemies across three distinct game modes:
• Survival - Team up with up to three other players to take down waves of increasingly difficult enemies on one of four maps. Fight to control territory on each map. While in control, you can choose to activate a Blessing to receive an advantage in battle, but losing control can activate a Curse that puts your team at a disadvantage.
• Story - Team up with another player to tackle a series of 12 missions. Work together, combining your unique skills to overcome a range of encounters, enemies and challenges.
• Incursion - Upon completing each set of three Story missions, you’ll unlock a large-scale, four-player assault on a stronghold belonging to a member of the Yōtei Six. Each Incursion will culminate in a boss fight versus a giant, supernatural version of The Spider, The Oni, The Kitsune, or The Snake.
